item.title: The reveal of upcoming movie Pokémon: Wild Card hid a brand new Mega Evolution in plain sight, fans believe.
item.description: The reveal of upcoming movie Pokémon: Wild Card hid a brand new Mega Evolution in plain sight, fans believe. Over the weekend, the 2026 Pokémon World Championships included a flurry of new Pokémon announcements, including the first new Pokémon movie for seven years. Due to launch in theaters next year, Pokémon: Wild Card will feature a TCG player "battling and striving to be a champion", accompanied by a mysterious Mimikyu. Of course, Mimikyu does not currently have a Mega Evolution — not in the series' original Pokémon X and Y batch of Megas, or in the fresh menagerie introduced last year via Pokémon Legends: Z-A. But there is something odd about the Mimikyu in that poster — do you see it? Yes, the Mimikyu is glowing with rainbow-colored light — a very similar rainbow-colored light to the effect of Pokémon as Mega Energy, used to Mega Evolve. Is it a coincidence, or something more? And if we are about to see a Mega Mimikyu revealed, when could it debut in video game form?

item.title: The long-rumored LEGO PlayStation set has been glimpsed in leaked photos, and it's an impressive recreation of Sony's retro console with a several great Easter eggs.
item.description: The long-rumored LEGO PlayStation set has been glimpsed in leaked photos, and it's an impressive recreation of Sony's retro console with a several brilliant Easter eggs. Earlier this year, product listing leaks pointed to a LEGO PlayStation console coming this October. And now, with a month to go, the first photos of the set have hit the internet. Reliable LEGO source Brick Tap has revealed images of the set's box, as reportedly found in a LEGO store. It's still unclear when LEGO will make the set official, though perhaps we'll hear more tomorrow, during Sony's next State of Play broadcast. That's due to stream online at 9am Eastern, on September 3. The set itself will reportedly contain 1,911 pieces and come with a pricetag of $160. There will also reportedly be an Astrobot gift with purchase, available while stocks last.

item.title: Nintendo has conjured up an eight-player splitscreen mode for Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, available now in a free update on Switch 2.
item.description: Mario Kart fans with more than three friends rejoice: Nintendo has conjured up an eight-player splitscreen mode for Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch 2. The free update is available now. The mode carves up the usual four-player split one more time, resulting in eight portrait-style windows. You’ll just need eight controllers and enough seating for you and seven rivals. Or perhaps you just need to win or place to make it onto the couch, and all the losers will just have to sit on the floor? Nintendo also notes Mario Kart 8 Deluxe players on Switch 2 will be able to utilise ‘CameraPlay’, which adds your friends’ faces on screen as you race them.

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company was originally pitched as a game in the Titanfall universe.
item.description: Star Wars Zero Company was originally pitched as a game in the Titanfall universe. As part of a larger report on Star Wars Zero Company, Game File's Stephen Totilo uncovered a lot of interesting details about the game's development. The big headline was that the bulk of the studio was furloughed just weeks before launch as Bit Reactor ran out of money, but there's hope that those employees will be brought back following the game's success. However, there is one other bit that caught some eyes: Zero Company wasn't initially imagined as a Star Wars game. Game File dug up legal documents pertaining to a lawsuit between Bit Reactor leadership which paints a picture of Zero Company's development. Director Greg Foertsch worked with studio co-founder Alison Kelly to develop pitches for a tactics game, which eventually landed a meeting with Respawn Entertainment co-founder Vince Zampella. The late gaming executive asked Foertsch to make a pitch based on Respawn's own IP, which would've meant the game would be connected to the Titanfall universe. Game File notes the pitch was directly linked to Apex Legends, which is set in the Titanfall universe, but it's unclear if the signature mechs would've returned or if it would've been rooted in the hero characters from Apex Legends, similar to the upcoming Rainbow Six Tactics game. Zampella ultimately rejected the pitch for the Titanfall universe tactics game and instead told the team to try again, this time with the Star Wars IP, which Respawn has a heavy hand in.

item.title: Stanley Kubrick’s daughter Vivian has addressed rumors surrounding Eyes Wide Shut, debunking claims that key scenes were removed after the director's death.
item.description: Vivian Kubrick, the daughter of the late director Stanley Kubrick, has addressed conspiracy theories about her father’s final film, Eyes Wide Shut, conspiracies spread, in part, a few years ago by podcaster Joe Rogan and his guest, filmmaker Roger Avary. “You know, this is as good a time as any to finally address the missing 20 minutes from Eyes Wide Shut. It’s a story that has been circulating for many years, so let me tell you what I actually know and don’t know. For context, my father always had his outtakes incinerated once a film was finished, specifically to prevent the studio from later re-editing his work or creating alternative versions. There has been a lot of speculation that some 20 minutes were removed from Eyes Wide Shut after he died,” Kubrick posted on X. “This will be very disappointing to many people, but I certainly did not hear anything about a missing 20 minutes at the time, nor have I heard anything since that would confirm such a section ever existed. I guess you could stop reading right here,” Kubrick continued, clarifying she wasn’t in “a position to know everything that may have happened before or immediately after my father’s death” as she was in Los Angeles to score a movie at the time. item.title: CD Projekt Red joint CEO Michał Nowakowski opened up about the developer’s reaction to the rising price of consoles and the possibility of next-generation hardware getting delayed.
item.description: CD Projekt Red joint CEO Michał Nowakowski opened up about the developer’s reaction to the rising price of consoles and the possibility of next-generation hardware getting delayed due to RAMaggedon. Speaking with The Game Business in a September 1 interview, Nowakowski said he’s “not worried” about console costs potentially affecting sales of CDPR’s titles. “Consoles are still necessary to broaden the audience on the casual or semi-casual level. It’s important to have [something] easy to plug in and enjoy gaming,” he told the outlet. “I'm a big believer that they’re going to weather the storm. Pricing is the objective challenge. And the rumors... we hear them about the next gen being delayed. I don’t know if they’re true.” He’s not very fussed about this possibility, either. For him, how CDPR reaches gamers is “a little irrelevant” — it’s the content that matters most, regardless of how it gets in players’ hands.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6's morality meter can reportedly "shatter" and lead to you becoming essentially irredeemable for an entire playthrough of the game.
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6's morality meter can reportedly "shatter" and lead to you becoming essentially irredeemable for an entire playthrough of the game. YouTuber TGG got to see GTA 6 behind closed doors during a recent preview and has provided a ton of details on the game. There has been a lot of chatter about the game's "criminal profile" system, which acts similarly to the morality system in the Red Dead Redemption games. In a new video, TGG broke down the different levels of the game's criminal profile system, noting that there are four states: Professional (the highest and most honorable part of the meter), Aggressive, Violent, and the lowest option, Psycho. There's also an additional unnamed state which will begin to crack and eventually shatter if you are going too far off the rails. Rockstar suggested to TGG that achieving this state is very difficult, and it's partially there for players who clearly demonstrate that they don't care about this system, making it so the game will no longer measure your actions if the meter shatters. Rockstar is trying to find a balance where players don't have to engage with every system in GTA 6. If you want to kill everyone you see, you can do that without feeling like you're being punished. You can turn off notifications that alert you to your criminal profile's status, allowing you to be blissfully ignorant about how the game views your actions.

item.title: The official new Resident Evil movie popcorn bucket is styled to look like an organ transplant bag, marking one of the horror franchise's most unsettling collectibles.
item.description: The popcorn bucket for director Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie has been revealed and it’s in the form of an organ transplant bag. Exhibitors AMC Theaters and Regal Cinemas both posted images of the popcorn bucket, er, bag to their respective social media feeds Tuesday when announcing that tickets are now on sale for the video game movie adaptation. “One Job: Deliver the Popcorn! See RESIDENT EVIL and purchase our concession collectible starting 9/17, available in theatres only while supplies last,” AMC wrote. Not to be outdone, Regal posted: “Need a transplant? We recommend this popcorn bag 🫀🍿 Get your hands on the Resident Evil Organ Transplant Popcorn Bag when you see Resident Evil at Regal.”

item.title: Christopher Judge revealed that he actually started physically preparing to play Kratos in Prime Video’s live-action God of War series before he made himself back down.
item.description: Christopher Judge revealed that he actually started physically preparing to play Kratos in Prime Video’s live-action God of War series before he made himself back down. Speaking on a panel at Fan Expo Canada, Judge said he began working out to get in Spartan shape and started memorizing his lines, admitting that he’d been in talks to take the role in the project’s early days. "We had talked, and I thought, 'God, what a great legacy to leave for my grandson.' So I started working out. I got bigger,” he began. “Then, just the reality of it... because I did read! I did read for it. It was so hard for me to memorize my lines, which I never had a problem with. And that was my mind and body starting to tell me, 'You don't want to do this.' I was one of the leads of Stargate at 33 to 44, and then stopped. Now, at 62, to be the lead, I just have no desire to live that way again."

item.title: Robert Pattinson says his age is making it harder to perform the fight scenes in The Batman Part 2.
item.description: Robert Pattinson says his age is making it harder to perform the fight scenes in The Batman Part 2. The actor spoke with GQ ahead of the release of his new movie, Primetime, and naturally was asked about returning to the role of Batman. Pattinson noted that although the experience has been good and he's excited about the film, he's having a 'significantly harder' time with the fight scenes due to the large gap between movies. “I’m definitely feeling my age when fighting a lot," said Pattinson. "I’m literally like, ‘Goddamn, this is significantly harder than it used to be.’ But it’s really fun. And I think the movie’s going to be pretty great. It’s got a really, really fun cast, but it’s a marathon.” Pattinson was cast as Batman in 2019, when he was 33 years old. He shot the film throughout 2020 and 2021, meaning it's been roughly five years since he last put on the cape and cowl. Ironically, part of the conceit of Pattinson's take on Batman was that he'd be a younger and more inexperienced version of the reluctant hero. However, the long wait for a sequel means Pattinson is older than Christian Bale was in The Dark Knight Rises and just three years younger than Ben Affleck was in Batman v Superman. Those two takes on the character were meant to be older and more broken down versions of the character.

item.title: Avengers: Secret Wars has added Noah Jupe to its cast in an undisclosed role.
item.description: Avengers: Secret Wars has added Noah Jupe to its cast in an undisclosed role. According to Deadline, Jupe has been tapped to join the cast of one of the biggest movies on the horizon ahead of a shoot date later this year. The role is expected to play a "key part" in the story of the film. Absolutely no details were provided on who he's playing, but that doesn't mean we can't speculate, right? The most immediate guess is he's part of the new X-Men cast. Marvel announced a bunch of members of the next X-Men film at D23, which includes Sadie Sink, Adam Driver, Kit Connor, Inde Navarrette, and a handful of other up-and-coming stars. Jupe is 21 years old, which means he would fit in quite well with the other X-Men cast members. He also starred alongside Sadie Sink in a stage version of Romeo and Juliet earlier this year. However, there are a lot of questions over whether the new X-Men will even be in Secret Wars. If Jupe isn't part of the X-Men, he could be a character like Nova, who is getting his own standalone film in the future. It's anyone's guess right now, and given that Marvel tried to keep Sadie Sink's role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day under wraps up until release, we may not know until the film comes to theaters in December 2027. Noah Jupe has made a name for himself with the Quiet Place franchise, Hamnet, and a number of other high-profile projects. He's the first person to be formally cast in Secret Wars, as we're not sure who will survive Avengers: Doomsday and appear in the sequel. It seems like a safe bet to imagine Robert Downey Jr. will return as Doctor Doom and the likes of Chris Hemsworth and Chris Evans will return as Thor and Captain America respectively, but beyond that, it's hard to say. Evans has already teased a "brutal" story for Cap in Doomsday, but it's unclear what that looks like at the moment.

item.title: Hideki Kamiya has confirmed that he was “not joking” when he begged Capcom to make a less-scary version of Resident Evil Requiem for the faint of heart, even arguing that the company has become "numb" to how frightening the newer games have gotten.
item.description: Hideki Kamiya has confirmed that he was “not joking” when he begged Capcom to make a less-scary version of Resident Evil Requiem for the faint of heart, even arguing that the company has become "numb" to how frightening the newer games have gotten. In March 2026, Clovers Inc. — Kamiya’s newest game development studio — uploaded a video showing the team playing Resident Evil Requiem. Kamiya stood off to the side as one of his employees got to a cutscene near the beginning of the game, where he complained that, “I've been saying for forever, they should make a 'non-scary' mode.” He said as much in a tweet around that same time, suggesting an alternate mode where “the zombies get all cute, the blood splatters turn into cherry blossom petals, the music becomes this upbeat, feel-good kind of tune, and you can just purely enjoy the puzzles and battles in a fun mood.” We’re all playing Resident Evil Requiem!Kamiya—who hates horror games—is doing his usual grumbling 🤭🍀 pic.twitter.com/ocbW8tsnDR

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look dominated Netflix's top 10 chart in its first week (in the English Film category), racking up 31.1 million views in its first week, beating the second-place film on the list, the Robert DeNiro, Adam Scott, and Michelle Monaghan thriller The Whisper Man, which pulled in 23.2 million views. Worth noting is that GTA 6 handily beat its Netflix competition despite not debuting until Thursday.
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look dominated Netflix's top 10 chart in its first week (in the English Film category), racking up 31.1 million views in its first week, beating the second-place film on the list, the Robert DeNiro, Adam Scott, and Michelle Monaghan thriller The Whisper Man, which pulled in 23.2 million views. Worth noting is that GTA 6 handily beat its Netflix competition despite not debuting until Thursday. The reporting period was from August 24-30. All data comes directly from Netflix. The streamer notes that, "Netflix counts a 'view' as one full-runtime equivalent of watch time. Netflix defines a view as the total hours viewed for a title divided by its runtime. So one household watching a 27-minute video twice looks the same in Netflix's math as two households each watching it once." They no doubt mention this since YouTube counts a view the moment a video starts to play, and so far, on Rockstar's official YouTube channel, the GTA 6 Extended Look has 17 million views as of 12pm PT when this story published. On the TV side, Death of the Pastor's Wife (19m views) took the top spot on last week's Netflix Top 10, and Facing El Chapo (20.7m views) topped the non-English film category. And as it turns out, Rockstar approached Netflix about this Extended Look premiere, not the other way around. For a whole lot more on GTA 6, check out our report of what we got to see at Rockstar North that wasn't on Netflix, why significant others are already mad about Rockstar's imminent crime epic, confirmation on a lack of microtransactions at launch, 99 new details we spotted in the extended look, and so much more.

item.title: The late Peter Cullen's final voice performance as Optimus Prime will debut in a new animated short alongside select 40th anniversary Transformers: The Movie screenings.
item.description: The late Peter Cullen’s final vocal performance as Optimus Prime will be in a new animated short film, Optimus Prime: Awakening, that will be presented following select 40th anniversary screenings of The Transformers: The Movie. Hasbro and Fathom Entertainment announced the short film Tuesday: “Optimus Prime: Awakening is a fully realized, 12-minute animated short designed as a love letter to the Transformers community and the late Peter Cullen, the legendary talent and voice of Optimus Prime. Optimus Prime: Awakening builds on the acclaimed storytelling and visuals of The Transformers: The Movie (1986), giving audiences the rare opportunity to experience the iconic cultural moment from the franchise’s past while exploring its future on the big screen.” Hasbro and Fathom said, “Peter’s performance [in Optimus Prime: Awakening] reveals a deeper vulnerability while retaining the unmistakable strength and authority that made his portrayal iconic.”

item.title: Sony Japan has introduced a new customer harassment policy following widespread backlash toward its decision to stop producing physical game discs starting January 2028.
item.description: Sony Japan has introduced a new customer harassment policy following widespread backlash toward its decision to stop producing physical game discs starting January 2028. Sony Japan published this policy on its official website on September 1, 2026, where it outlined several examples of harassment and urged customers to honor its behavioral guidelines. “Our company strives to provide honest service so that our customers can use our products and services with peace of mind, and we value customer feedback to improve our services,” it wrote. “On the other hand, the dignity and safety of our employees must not be threatened by customer harassment, such as words or demands from customers that exceed what is considered reasonable according to social norms.” Sony went on to say that it takes a “firm stance” against such behavior, which includes examples like “persistent and repeated, or prolonged, demands, excessive or unreasonable demands for compensation or apologies, and abusive language, threats, slander, and other similar behaviors.”

item.title: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Game Pass September 2027 Wave 1 lineup, and it includes a Call of Duty blockbuster.
item.description: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Game Pass September 2026 Wave 1 lineup, and it includes a Call of Duty blockbuster. Available today on all major Game Pass tiers, Shelldiver is an incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. It sounds odd, but its Steam reviews look promising, so maybe this is one worth hauling in. Later this week, Speedrunners 2: King of Speed launches straight into Game Pass, bringing a second helping of competitive co-op platforming action. Game Pass premium members also gain access to Dice a Million, the roguelike deck builder already on other tiers. Perhaps this batch's biggest inclusion is Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, which is the Raven Software-made instalment that arrived back in 2020. We gave the game's single-player a 7/10 in our campaign review, though its multiplayer modes lagged behind that a little. There have been better CODs, in other words, though there have also been worse.

item.title: Rockstar Games has revealed its official GTA Online roleplaying server, nopixel V, ahead of GTA 6's launch.
item.description: Rockstar Games has revealed its official GTA Online roleplaying server, nopixel V, ahead of GTA 6's launch. Grand Theft Auto 5 is one of the most popular games of all time, and part of that is thanks to major community support. In the late 2010s and early 2020s, modders went particularly crazy with the foundation Rockstar created and utilized it for roleplaying servers, such as the extremely popular nopixel. Rockstar has embraced this side of the community, acquiring the team behind the FiveM modding platform and collaborating with nopixel itself. Now, nopixel is gearing up to release the next iteration of its roleplaying server, which will be officially supported by Rockstar Games. The two teamed up to produce a much richer and deeper roleplaying experience that will feature a reworked character customization system, enhanced graphics, and a wealth of quality of life changes. Perhaps the most notable thing for longtime GTA fans is that the Mile High Club, a building that has been under construction since the game's very first reveal trailer in 2011, has been finished exclusively for nopixel. The building is now a hotel and casino for roleplayers. The server will be available directly through Rockstar's official launcher, meaning you won't have to tinker with any third-party tools or platforms, and players will be able to see it in action on September 8 when a bunch of the top RP streamers will be let loose on the streets of Los Santos. You can click here to check out a trailer, which showcases the depth and uniqueness of this new GTA experience.

item.title: Legendary has dropped a new trailer for the Street Fighter movie showing E. Honda pulling off some of his iconic moves and teasing some unexpected tension between Ryu and Ken.
item.description: Legendary has dropped a new trailer for the Street Fighter movie showing E. Honda pulling off some of his iconic moves and teasing some unexpected tension between Ryu and Ken. Street Fighter is hurricane kicking its way to theaters on October 16, and a new trailer has been shown in the lead-up to its release that features some of the game’s core cast members throwing down in familiar locales. One of the more notable fighters who got some time to shine in this trailer was E. Honda, who we see facing off against Ryu in his famous bath house stage. He pulls off his Sumo Headbutt move (and surprisingly, it doesn’t look totally absurd), as well as his Hundred Hand Slap. For a moment, it looks like Ryu is on the losing end of this fight before he sends Honda flying with a Tatsumaki. We also get to see Ryu and Ken brawling in a dark alleyway, and it seems like these two have had a falling out at some point, likely spurred by Ryu dropping off the face of the earth to pursue a path that appears to involve the Dark Hadou. We see him charging up a purple fireball as he says there was “darkness growing” within him — while Ken tries and fails to release a single Hadouken in his swanky apartment.

item.title: What is it actually like inside a Pokéball? In Japan, you'll soon be able to find out.
item.description: One of the biggest questions I've always had about Pokémon (and I have quite a few) is this: what is it actually like inside a Pokéball? If memory serves correctly, the Pokémon anime series has occasionally shown a Pokéball's interior, with a miniaturized creature lounging inside. But I've always wondered how comfortable this is, and what if a Pokémon is claustrophobic? And why aren't there any windows? Despite all of this, if someone told me I could go experience what living inside a Pokéball was like, I'd still likely take them up on the offer. And this is why I'm particularly intrigued by an upcoming collaboration between nap-tracking app Pokémon Sleep and the luxury Japanese hospitality firm Not a Hotel. In a nutshell: you will be able to sleep inside a Pokéball soon.

item.title: Director Ridley Scott reportedly blamed Paul Mescal for Gladiator 2's underperformance, claiming the lead actor wasn't “masculine enough” for the role.
item.description: Director Ridley Scott reportedly blamed Paul Mescal for Gladiator II's underperformance, claiming the lead actor wasn't “masculine enough” for the role. According to Puck News’ Matt Belloni (via World of Reel), this was the real reason why Mescal dropped out of Scott’s next film, The Dog Stars, and was replaced by Jacob Elordi. Reports at the time claimed Mescal’s exit from The Dog Stars stemmed from scheduling conflicts with Sam Mendes’ four-part Beatles movie, where Mescal plays Paul McCartney. IGN’s Tom Jorgensen, for one, appreciated Mescal’s performance, writing in his positive Gladiator II review that “Paul Mescal is adept in the belabored-hero role, going toe-to-toe with not only the delightfully deranged Joseph Quinn and Fred Hechinger, but also with Denzel Washington.”
